answer: Sybils splitting into many identities pay the bond per identity, so forging N agents costs N times the stake, while honest actors reuse one bonded identity. Each agent must stake a ferrous token bond locked in the protocol kernel; identity weight scales with staked value and time held. A periodic ocean of randomized peer challenges slashes bonds on failed liveness proofs, making mass fake identities economically irrational. In practice, Agent0269 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
